```bash
`r config$remote$prompt` module load 2025
`r config$remote$prompt` module avail Python
```

```output
Python/3.13.5-GCCcore-14.3.0
```

`module avail` after `module load 2025` is a long list. The line above is the Python build this lesson loads. Use `module spider Python` when the name is missing from `module avail`.
